<thought>The 13C NMR spectrum shows peaks at 144.78, 132.00, 130.07 (twice), and 127.80 (twice) ppm, all within the typical aromatic carbon region (≈110–160 ppm). That accounts for 1 + 1 + 2 + 2 = 6 aromatic carbon atoms. The remaining peaks are outside this region, representing non‑aromatic carbons. Therefore, the molecule contains six aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
